title: single_game_v2_compact_2.7
description: Compact single-game output for LLM self-coaching, schema 2.7. Wave 1 over frozen 2.6: `summary.src` names the exact engine policy, `flags[].alts` carries rank 2/3 SANs, top-level `piece_reads` maps forcing pieces seen in measured PVs, and `pv_played_unavailable` gains `rank_unknown`. Calibration over 2.5: each flag publishes `bcp` (the D12 best-eval anchor) instead of the non-anchor `eval_before_mover_cp`, so `cp = bcp - eval_after_mover_cp` is arithmetically checkable; each pattern carries short `nm`/`mit` (name and mitigation) so an LLM can act on a pattern ID. Breaking over 2.4 (aliases removed), otherwise additive over 2.3 (schemas/single_game_v2_compact_2.3.json is the frozen 2.3 snapshot): a `*_to_mate` game_impact now carries its `mate_after` direction, and a top-level `pipeline` block separates analysis completeness from coaching source, so `use_llm=false` cannot read as 'analysis failed'. 2.3 split confidence into three named dimensions (P0-4). `conf` is and remains the ordinal detection_strength; patterns[].support is the measured share of flagged moves covered, and top-level confidence_dims explains that behavioral_confidence is null with a reason because no mechanism calibration exists yet. 2.2 also added mandatory game_impact, mate_missed/mate_via, pv_played/pv_played_unavailable, clusters[].plies and summary.acc_warning. Derived from contract v1.2; instrumentation and derivable fields are omitted. Null means 'not measured' - it is never replaced by a guessed number. Null policy per field: summary.acpl / summary.phases[*][0] are null when the phase had no measured move; flags[].rank is null when the engine did not measure the played-move rank; flags[].game_impact is null when the evals were not measured; flags[].motif is omitted when the move has no tactical motif (a present motif is always a string); `bcp` and `eval_after_mover_cp` are omitted outside the FIX-015 window (cp > 200 or class blunder/mistake) or when the evaluation was not measured. The non-anchor `eval_before_mover_cp` was removed in 2.6 (it does not satisfy `cp = bcp - eval_after`); `eval_before`/`eval_after` aliases were removed in 2.5. Unavailable PV for a blunder/mistake is published in pv_unavailable instead of being silently omitted. P0-7: every flagged move is either covered by a pattern (pstatus=matched, patterns present) or states why no pattern covers it (pstatus=unclassified, why present). The reason is a measured shape of the move, not a claimed mechanism. D9: flags[].eval_before_mover_cp / eval_after_mover_cp are the canonical POV-named keys (2.5 removed the deprecated aliases). 2.5 also widens summary.acc_warning to contains_blunder/contains_mistake and names the exact engine policy in detailed eval_source.

username.description: Player whose side is analysed. Omitted for anonymous games / when unknown.

src.description: 2.7: short engine policy label from detailed eval_provenance, e.g. d14n150k_h64_live or d14n150k_hash_unknown_cache.

acpl.description: Mean centipawn loss. Null when no move was measured.

acc.description: Internal accuracy score 0-100 (see acc_method). Null when no move was measured.

acc_method.description: P1: how acc was computed. internal_cp_linear = mean(max(0, 100 - 0.15*cp_loss)); NOT Lichess accuracy.

acc_warning.description: D33: the linear score hides at least one mate-level swing (a missed mate or a forced mate after the move). The score is still correct for the other moves; it must not be presented as 'you played well' on its own.

phase_method.description: P0-3: which phase source the detectors used. 'mixed' means the moves came from caches with different phase methods.

flags.description: One entry per flagged move (blunder, mistake, inaccuracy), ordered by ply ascending.

best.description: SAN of the engine best move

rank.description: Played move rank among engine candidates; null when not measured (engine timeout). Never 0.

game_impact.description: D29/2.2: did the game change, from the mover's point of view. Nine sign transitions with a documented +/-100 cp dead zone, plus three mate transitions; a forced mate is never reported as losing_to_losing. Null = eval not measured.

pstatus.description: P0-7: 'matched' = at least one pattern covers this ply (patterns present); 'unclassified' = no pattern covers it (why present).

why.description: P0-7: measured reason the detector is silent. 'evidence_gap' = no engine line/best move/rank. 'quiet_positional' = no capture, no check, not in check. 'quiet_blunder' = same quiet shape but cp_loss > 200 (D13). 'check_escape' = non-capturing king move out of check (D14). 'forcing_move_unexplained' = check given or faced without a pattern. 'capture_unexplained' = capture below the B threshold. 'mechanism_not_identified' = explicit fallback. 'not_classified' = source payload predates P0-7. Never a claimed mechanism.

motif.description: Tactical motif tag, e.g. discovered_check_capture. Omitted when the move has no tactical motif; null is not used here.

bcp.description: 2.6: D12 anchor `best_eval_mover_cp` — the eval of the engine's best move, mover POV. This is the value `cp` is measured from, so `cp == bcp - eval_after_mover_cp` whenever both are present. null = anchor not measured.

eval_after_mover_cp.description: D9: engine eval in centipawns from the point of view of the player who made the flagged move, after the move. The sign is not flipped; eval_after is not the opponent's POV.

alts.description: 2.7: best rank-2 SAN alternative from the same engine search, for flags whose played rank is >= 3. These are measured lines, not the opponent's actual reply.

patterns.description: Behavioural pattern ids whose evidence includes this ply (CAND-E). Present iff pstatus=matched.

mate_in.description: FIX-027: forced mate in N moves from the engine's best line. Positive = mate for the player, negative = mate against the player. Only emitted for blunders whose best line is mate; eval_cp stays null in that case.

mate_missed.description: D31/2.2: the engine's best line mates for the mover in N moves and the played move does not reach a forced mate. Explains why cp_loss can be ~9000 while game_impact says winning_to_winning.

mate_via.description: D31/2.2: SAN of the mating move the engine found. Present iff mate_missed is present and the best line names it.

mate_after.description: 2.4: direction of a forced mate AFTER the played move. `for` = mover mates, `against` = mover is mated. Mandatory and non-null exactly when game_impact ends in `_to_mate`; null otherwise. Without it an LLM cannot tell who was mated.

nm.description: 2.6: short snake_case pattern name so an LLM never sees a bare ID. Full name stays in detailed.

mit.description: 2.6: short actionable mitigation (<=50 chars). Full mitigation stays in detailed.

conf.description: P0-4: ordinal detection_strength, NOT a probability. See confidence_dims.

support.description: P0-4/2.3: measured share of flagged moves in this game covered by the pattern (evidence_support). Basis and denominator are in confidence_dims. null = no measured move to divide by (legacy payload).

patterns_meta.description: P0-8: mandatory. An empty `patterns` list always has a reason, and coverage proves every flag is accounted for.

confidence_dims.description: P0-4/2.3: mandatory. Names which confidence dimension is published so an LLM never reads an ordinal detector weight as a probability.

pipeline.description: 2.4: mandatory. Separates analysis completeness from coaching source. Without it, `status=degraded` with `use_llm=false` reads as 'the analysis failed' even when every measured ply is present.

coaching.description: Source of the published report: provider/MCP output, deterministic fallback, raw data dump, or a pipeline error.

llm_requested.description: False means the caller deliberately disabled LLM providers (offline ETL), not that every provider failed.

piece_reads.description: 2.7/Wave 1: ply -> up to two forcing pieces actually seen in the measured PV. Qualitative board signal for LLM narrative; never an inferred threat.

unclassified.description: P0-7 discovery feed: critical moments no pattern explains, ordered by ply. Omitted when empty; when present it lists exactly the flags with pstatus=unclassified.

pv.description: Optional. Map ply (string) -> principal variation SAN moves, max 3. Only for flagged plies with measured engine lines. A ply absent here but present in pv_unavailable has no PV for the stated reason.

pv_unavailable.description: Optional. Map ply (string) -> reason why no PV exists for a blunder/mistake. Makes a data gap explicit (FIX-014).

pv_played.description: D32/2.2: optional. Map ply (string) -> engine continuation AFTER the played move (max 3 SAN), taken from the same multipv search as `pv`. This is an engine line, not the opponent's actual reply, and it must never be narrated as one.

pv_played_unavailable.description: D32/2.2, 2.7: optional. Map ply (string) -> reason why no played-move continuation exists. 'rank_unknown' = engine did not measure a rank (timeout); 'rank_not_in_engine_lines' = played move was outside multipv; 'no_continuation' = line stopped; 'no_engine_lines' = nothing measured.

clusters.description: Optional. Runs of >= 3 flagged moves on consecutive own moves (plies step by 2), i.e. a likely time-pressure / attention cluster (CAND-F).

plies.description: D32/2.2: the plies the run contains, ascending; length equals count, first equals from, last equals to.

fen_before.description: Optional. Map ply (string) -> FEN before the flagged move. Only for cp_loss > 100.

report.description: Optional short deterministic summary. Never truncated mid-structure. Capped at 900 chars to keep the compact budget.

phase.description: [acpl, flagged_count]; acpl is null when the phase had no measured moves.
